'''Corrimias''' was a [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]] who preached about equality and peace. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] member [[Dorrian Vodani]] looked up to him, going so far as to apply Corrimias' teachings in his daily life.<ref name="OoA1" />
